watch.hypothesis: Canada’s energy leadership may be broadening from oil-and-gas producers into pipelines and midstream.
watch.why_watch: Oil and gas remains the dominant, cohesive theme, while pipelines retain a trend tag, 0.71 durability, and 50% breadth without the producer group’s crowding flag. The overall rotation is still narrow and non-directional, so this is not a forecast of a handoff.
watch.confirmation_condition: By 2026-11-13, pipelines remain trend-tagged and eligible while breadth rises materially above 0.50, alongside continued positive trend health in oil-and-gas producers.
watch.retire_condition: Retire the watch if pipelines become ineligible, lose their trend tag, or breadth falls below 0.33.
watch.discipline: The detector’s ranks, durability, and crowding measures are coincident focus tools, not return signals. Producer crowding is neither a sell nor a reason to fade the leader; only the absolute-trend gate has validated drawdown-control value.
